name: open-data-bridge
description: Local-first Windsor-style marketing data bridge with 367-source discovery, nested queries, exports and approval-gated Meta publishing.

interface.longDescription: Local MCP bridge with the public 367-source catalog, fields, options, accounts, nested filters, date presets, blended queries, pagination and exports, plus verified Facebook Page and Instagram publishing contracts. Provider publishing is approval-gated, token-safe and blocked until the operator completes Meta OAuth and account discovery.
